title: Vectr language contract
description: The complete, machine-readable Vectr scene language. A document that satisfies `$defs/Scene` is a well-formed scene. The parser additionally enforces the structural rules the descriptions here name, such as a text element never being an operand of a composition element.

Scene.title: Scene
Scene.description: A single authored graphic described in the Vectr language.

projectId.description: References the ProjectConfig this scene belongs to.

formatVersion.description: The declared format version of this scene; this build supports 0.2.

paletteId.description: References the Palette whose tokens the scene's elements use.

recipeId.description: References the StyleRecipe applied to the scene, if any.

title.description: Accessible title carried into exported output.

description.description: Accessible description carried into exported output.

elements.description: The scene's elements; an empty list is a valid, empty scene.

constraints.description: Relationships resolved into concrete geometry at compile time.

background.description: Canvas background color in any format SVG supports, or 'transparent'.

Element.title: Element
Element.description: One drawing entity in a scene: a primitive, a group, a composition operation, or a text run. Elements form a tree through parentId, and paint order follows order. A group or composition element acts on its child elements, the elements whose parentId references it, in paint order. Fill and stroke are independent: an element may carry either, both, or neither. A stroke is well-formed only when profileId and paint are both present.

sceneId.description: References the Scene this element belongs to; null when the element belongs to a Definition. Exactly one of sceneId and definitionId is set.

definitionId.description: References the Definition this element belongs to; null when the element belongs to a Scene.

parentId.description: References the parent Element, or null for a root element.

order.description: Paint order among siblings; lower values paint first.

name.description: Element name, preserved in exported output.

fill.description: The element's fill paint, or null for no fill.

stroke.description: The element's stroke, or null for no stroke.

fontId.description: References the Asset of kind font used to render a text element, or null to use the default open-licensed font. Applies only to a text element.

definitionRef.description: References the Definition this element places; required when kind is instance and null otherwise.

bindings.description: Values bound to the placed definition's parameters; applies only to an instance.

overrides.description: Appearance overrides applied to this instance only; applies only to an instance.

Definition.title: Definition
Definition.description: A named, project-scoped reusable part: a group of elements that any scene in the project can place by reference, one or many times. A definition is not rendered unless an instance element references it. Its elements are the Element rows whose definitionId references it. Because it is project-scoped, editing a definition changes what every scene that places it renders on the next compile.

id.description: Stable identifier for the definition, unique within its project.

projectId.description: References the ProjectConfig this definition belongs to.

parameters.description: The named inputs the definition accepts; an instance binds each one, or the parameter's default applies.

elements.description: The definition's element tree; each element's definitionId references this definition.

TemplateElement.title: TemplateElement
TemplateElement.description: One element of a definition: a template whose parameter-capable fields hold either a literal or the object { "param": "<name>" }. Expansion resolves each reference against an instance's bindings into a concrete Element.

id.description: Stable identifier for the element, unique within its definition.

definitionId.description: References the Definition this element belongs to.

parentId.description: References the parent element, or null for a root element.

order.description: Paint order among siblings; lower values paint first.

name.description: Element name, preserved in exported output.

fill.description: The element's fill paint, or a token parameter reference, or null for no fill.

stroke.description: The element's stroke, or null for no stroke.

fontId.description: References the Asset of kind font used to render a text element.

definitionRef.description: References the Definition an instance element places.

bindings.description: Values an instance binds to the placed definition's parameters.

overrides.description: Appearance overrides an instance applies to the placed definition.

TemplateGeometry.title: TemplateGeometry
TemplateGeometry.description: A definition element's geometry; numeric and string fields may hold a parameter reference.

points.description: Point list for polygon and line elements.

TemplateTransform.title: TemplateTransform
TemplateTransform.description: A definition element's transform; its numeric fields may hold a parameter reference.

TemplateStroke.title: TemplateStroke
TemplateStroke.description: A definition element's stroke: a profile and a paint that may be a token parameter reference.

profileId.description: References the StrokeProfile supplying the stroke's width, cap, and join.

Parameter.title: Parameter
Parameter.description: One named input a definition accepts.

default.description: Value used when an instance does not bind the parameter; null means the parameter has no default and a binding is required.

ParameterType.title: ParameterType
ParameterType.description: The kind of value a parameter accepts.

Origin.title: Origin
Origin.description: A definition's local coordinate frame; an instance places the definition by transforming this origin.

x.description: X of the definition's origin in scene units.

y.description: Y of the definition's origin in scene units.

NumberValue.title: NumberValue
NumberValue.description: A number that is either a literal or a parameter reference.

StringValue.title: StringValue
StringValue.description: A string that is either a literal or a parameter reference.

BoolValue.title: BoolValue
BoolValue.description: A boolean that is either a literal or a parameter reference.

PaintValue.title: PaintValue
PaintValue.description: A paint that is either a literal or a token parameter reference.

ParamRef.title: ParamRef
ParamRef.description: A reference to a declared parameter, written { "param": "<name>" }.

param.description: The name of the parameter being referenced.

Binding.title: Binding
Binding.description: One value an instance binds to a placed definition's parameter.

name.description: The name of the parameter being bound.

BindingValue.title: BindingValue
BindingValue.description: The value of a binding: a literal, or a parameter reference forwarding an enclosing definition's parameter.

Override.title: Override
Override.description: One appearance override an instance applies to a placed definition element; a field left out is inherited, and an explicit null fill or stroke clears it.

target.description: Identifier of the placed definition's element whose appearance changes.

Geometry.title: Geometry
Geometry.description: The element's geometry; which fields apply depends on kind. A rect and an ellipse are placed by the x and y origin of their bounding box and sized by width and height, with the ellipse inscribed in that box and rx and ry rounding a rect's corners. A text element is anchored by x and y at the baseline of its first line, sized by fontSize, and wrapped to width when width is set.

x.description: X origin of the bounding box in scene units; for a text element, the anchor of its first line.

y.description: Y origin of the bounding box in scene units; for a text element, the baseline of its first line.

width.description: Bounding-box width for rect-like and ellipse elements, and the wrap width for text elements.

height.description: Bounding-box height for rect-like and ellipse elements.

rx.description: Corner radius in X for rect elements.

ry.description: Corner radius in Y for rect elements.

points.description: Point list for polygon and line elements.

pathData.description: Path data for path elements; for an alongPath element it is the guide path its children follow.

text.description: The string a text element renders.

fontSize.description: Em size in scene units for a text element.

lineHeight.description: Baseline-to-baseline distance in scene units for a text element.

letterSpacing.description: Additional advance between the glyphs of a text element, in scene units.

count.description: Number of copies for repeat elements.

spacing.description: Distance between successive copies for repeat elements, along the element's local x-axis.

distance.description: Outline offset distance in scene units for offset elements; positive offsets outward and negative inward.

Transform.title: Transform
Transform.description: Affine transform applied to the element and its children. The fields compose in a fixed order: a point in the element's local coordinates is first skewed by skewX and skewY, then scaled by scaleX and scaleY, then rotated by rotate degrees, and finally translated by translateX and translateY; rotation and scaling are about the element's origin.

Paint.title: Paint
Paint.description: A paint names either a Palette token (a solid fill) or a Gradient (a gradient fill). The reference is a name, resolved by the compiler rather than at parse time.

ref.description: The Palette token name when kind is token, or the Gradient id when kind is gradient.

Stroke.title: Stroke
Stroke.description: The element's stroke. A stroke pairs a StrokeProfile, supplying the width, cap, and join, with a paint.

profileId.description: References the StrokeProfile supplying the stroke's width, cap, and join.

Constraint.title: Constraint
Constraint.description: A stated relationship resolved into concrete geometry at compile time.

sceneId.description: References the Scene this constraint belongs to.

elementIds.description: References the Elements the constraint relates.

axis.description: The axis the constraint applies to, or null when not axis-specific.

value.description: The numeric value the constraint targets, such as spacing; null when not applicable.

Palette.title: Palette
Palette.description: A named set of color tokens that scenes reference by token name.

projectId.description: References the ProjectConfig this palette belongs to.

tokens.description: The color tokens in the palette.

value.description: Color value in any format SVG supports, optionally carrying alpha: 3-, 4-, 6-, or 8-digit hexadecimal, rgb() and rgba(), hsl() and hsla(), a named color, or 'transparent'. Alpha in the value sets that paint's opacity, so a fill and a stroke carry independent alpha.

description.description: What the color is used for.

StrokeProfile.title: StrokeProfile
StrokeProfile.description: A named stroke configuration that elements reference. It carries the stroke's geometry only — width, cap, and join; the stroke's paint comes from the element, not from the profile.

projectId.description: References the ProjectConfig this profile belongs to.

StyleRecipe.title: StyleRecipe
StyleRecipe.description: A named rendering recipe that governs how a scene is composed and shaded. Version one ships flat, line-art, geometric, and isometric.

projectId.description: References the ProjectConfig this recipe belongs to.

gridSize.description: Grid spacing for snapping, where the recipe uses a grid.

snap.description: Whether elements snap to the grid.

shadeToken.description: Name of the Palette token supplying the single shading layer's color; required when shading is single-layer.

strokeWeight.description: Default stroke weight for stroke-based recipes.

Gradient.title: Gradient
Gradient.description: A named gradient paint that an element's fill or stroke can reference. A gradient is linear or radial, and each of its color stops draws its color from a palette token.

projectId.description: References the ProjectConfig this gradient belongs to.

stops.description: The gradient's color stops, ordered along the gradient vector.

x1.description: Start x of a linear gradient in object bounding-box units; defaults to 0.

y1.description: Start y of a linear gradient in object bounding-box units; defaults to 0.

x2.description: End x of a linear gradient in object bounding-box units; defaults to 1.

y2.description: End y of a linear gradient in object bounding-box units; defaults to 0.

cx.description: Center x of a radial gradient in object bounding-box units; defaults to 0.5.

cy.description: Center y of a radial gradient in object bounding-box units; defaults to 0.5.

r.description: Radius of a radial gradient in object bounding-box units; defaults to 0.5.

fx.description: Focal x of a radial gradient in object bounding-box units; defaults to the center x.

fy.description: Focal y of a radial gradient in object bounding-box units; defaults to the center y.

GradientStop.title: GradientStop
GradientStop.description: A single color stop, taking its color from the palette token it names.

offset.description: Position of the stop along the gradient vector, from 0 to 1.

token.description: Name of the Palette token supplying the stop's color.

opacity.description: Stop opacity, from 0 to 1; defaults to 1.

Asset.title: Asset
Asset.description: An external file a scene references, such as a font or an image.

sceneId.description: References the Scene that uses the asset.

description.description: What the asset is used for.

ProjectConfig.title: ProjectConfig
ProjectConfig.description: The per-project settings that govern how scenes in the project are compiled and exported.

formatVersion.description: The scene format version this project targets; this build supports 0.2.

defaultRecipeId.description: References the StyleRecipe applied when a scene does not name one.

ProjectOutput.title: ProjectOutput
ProjectOutput.description: Default export settings for the project.

background.description: Default background color in any format SVG supports, or 'transparent'.

Export.title: Export
Export.description: A record of one export of a scene to a format.

sceneId.description: References the Scene that was exported.

path.description: Location of the written output file.

EvaluationCorpus.title: EvaluationCorpus
EvaluationCorpus.description: A versioned set of authoring prompts used to measure cross-model quality.

version.description: Version of the corpus; comparisons are only valid within one version.

Prompt.title: Prompt
Prompt.description: One authoring task in an evaluation corpus.

corpusId.description: References the EvaluationCorpus this prompt belongs to.

intent.description: The graphic the prompt asks for.

text.description: The natural-language request given to the authoring model.

order.description: Order of the prompt in the corpus.

AuthoringModel.title: AuthoringModel
AuthoringModel.description: A model used to author scenes during evaluation, with the pinned version the score applies to.

id.description: Stable identifier for the model entry.

version.description: Pinned model version the score applies to.

EvaluationRun.title: EvaluationRun
EvaluationRun.description: The result of running one corpus through one authoring model.

corpusId.description: References the EvaluationCorpus that was run.

authoringModelId.description: References the AuthoringModel that authored the scenes.

compileSuccessRate.description: Share of authored scenes that compiled without error.

fidelityScore.description: Judged visual fidelity score for the run.

regression.description: Whether the run regressed against the previous run of the same corpus and model.

PaintKind.title: PaintKind
PaintKind.description: Whether the reference names a palette token or a gradient.

ConstraintKind.title: ConstraintKind
ConstraintKind.description: The type of relationship a constraint expresses.

Axis.title: Axis
Axis.description: The axis a constraint applies to.

ProjectionAxis.title: ProjectionAxis
ProjectionAxis.description: The axes a projection element maps its children onto.

BooleanOperation.title: BooleanOperation
BooleanOperation.description: A boolean composition operation: union combines the children, subtract removes the later children from the first, and intersect keeps their common area.

TextAlign.title: TextAlign
TextAlign.description: Horizontal alignment of the lines of a text element about its anchor.

RecipeName.title: RecipeName
RecipeName.description: The recipe selected. Version one ships flat, line-art, geometric, and isometric.

LightDirection.title: LightDirection
LightDirection.description: Direction the scene's light comes from when shading is single-layer; the shading falls on the opposite side. Defaults to topLeft.

GradientType.title: GradientType
GradientType.description: The gradient's geometry: a linear gradient transitions along a straight line and a radial gradient radiates from a center.

Spread.title: Spread
Spread.description: How the gradient extends beyond its ends; defaults to pad.
